ref.substituent_description: Pyrrolo[2,3-d]pyrimidin-4-one: pyrrole N bears Me, the adjacent carbon bears I; pyrimidinone N3 carries CH2 to C4 of a 4-hydroxypiperidine. The piperidine N is acylated by C(=O) attached by a solid wedge to C4 of a second piperidine, whose C3 bears Ph on a hashed bond and whose N bears Boc.
ref.notes: Typeset. Double bonds: N=CH, C7a=C4a, C(I)=CH, ring C=O, amide C=O.

wrong.substituent_description: Same pyrrolopyrimidinone with I on the carbon next to the pyrrole N, but the pyrrole N has no substituent (no Me). N3-CH2 to C4 of 4-hydroxypiperidine; amide C(=O) on a solid wedge to C4 of N-Boc piperidine with Ph on a hashed bond at C3.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: I drawn as a bare vertical stroke
hashed wedge to Ph is a dense fan of lines that does not clearly touch the ring carbon or Ph
wrong.notes: Handwritten, black. Double bonds: N=CH, fusion C=C, C(I)=CH, ring C=O, amide C=O.

correct.substituent_description: Pyrrole N bears Me, adjacent carbon bears I; pyrimidinone N3-CH2 to C4 of 4-hydroxypiperidine; piperidine N-C(=O) on a solid wedge to C4 of N-Boc piperidine with Ph on a hashed bond at C3.
correct.notes: Handwritten, black. Double bonds: N=CH, fusion C=C, C(I)=CH, ring C=O, amide C=O.

errors_in_wrong.description: Reference pyrrole N (N7) carries a Me group; in the wrong drawing that N has no substituent, so the N-methyl is missing.
The hashed wedge from piperidine C3 to Ph is drawn as a detached dense fan of lines that does not clearly join the ring carbon or the Ph label.

review_notes: Wrong drawing omits the Me on the pyrrole N; otherwise the skeleton, I, HO, Boc, Ph and both stereo bonds match. Corrected drawing restores N-Me and matches the reference.
